scope: N4 offline generated-image registration to shared UV on immutable source geometry
cohort: all unique N0 SAM target and same-age outputs already refitted in N2; retain all failures and unknown source ages

sampling.geometry: each target's full fitted raw vertices including expression
sampling.projection: each target's own verified projection and ROI in its own 1024 image pixel frame
sampling.shared_uv: one pinned topology-bound BFM UV array preserving vertex order
sampling.uv_origin: BFM bottom left to glTF top left via (u,1-v)
sampling.rgb: bilinear target-generated RGB; every contributing pixel must be allowed by the target-local mask
sampling.visibility: native front faces and continuous max projected Z
sampling.forbidden_correspondence: no original source projection, inverse FFHQ source transform, or resized source valid-mask as generated-image correspondence

output_geometry.reference: original source full mesh and its fixed canonical center/scale
output_geometry.invariant: positions, normals, ordered indices and UV identical for every target of the same source
output_geometry.source_age_api: unknown; filename source-age label recorded separately as research provenance

mask_review.coordinate_frame: target image pixels, bound to target image hash
mask_review.method: target-own landmark convex hull with conservative erosion, mouth-interior exclusion and documented target-local glasses/fringe exclusions
mask_review.review_scope: all 37 target images viewed before atlas outcomes; masks and review notes saved before projection

construction.landmarks: target N2 projected_landmarks XY in its own image; nearest integer using numpy.rint
construction.initial_region: convex hull of landmark indices 0 through 26 inclusive; 9x9 all-ones erosion once
construction.mouth_unknown: convex hull of indices 60 through 67 inclusive; 7x7 all-ones dilation once, then exclude
construction.glasses_cases: four fgnet-004a63 targets: exclude the complete hull-supported band from floor(min eyebrow Y)-18 through row649; corrected after independent visual review before atlas outcomes
construction.fringe_cases: astronaut, fgnet-062a45 and fgnet-005a35 targets: exclude hull-supported pixels above ceil(max eyebrow Y)+10
construction.coordinate_limits: clip all regions to the target image; allowed and occluded-candidate masks must be disjoint L-mode PNG 0/255
construction.review_record: the final hash-bound per-target review records exact bands, notes, masks and excluded-pixel counts

mask_review.source_valid_mask: source resampling provenance only; not reused as a target eligibility mask
mask_review.limits: conservative reviewed masks are research exclusions, not exhaustive external-occluder segmentation or independently accepted quality

unknown_surface.classification: mutually exclusive UV outside, UV overlap, backface, image outside, self occlusion, target mask rejection and sampled generated pixel
unknown_surface.rgba: unsampled RGBA must be exactly zero
unknown_surface.fill: none; no reflection, symmetry, inpainting, dilation of color or cross-unknown blending
unknown_surface.terminology: generated sampled texels are not observed original-photo surface

seams.structural_checks: shared ordered UV, overlap classification, shared-edge continuity, unknown boundary and alpha preserved
seams.diagnostics: report adjacent sampled RGB differences without treating natural image gradients as seam error
seams.verification: synthetic linear RGB shared-edge counterexample plus actual front/side/reimport visual review

glb_roundtrip.offline: all 37 self-contained GLBs: embedded PNG and UV, finite source geometry, ordered indices, MASK alpha and CLAMP_TO_EDGE
glb_roundtrip.browser: all 37 targets in Chrome and Edge through actual FaceViewer load/export/reload
glb_roundtrip.checks: local positions, normals, indices, UV, decoded RGBA, alpha mask, color space, flipY, sampler/material settings and generated-texture provenance preserved
glb_roundtrip.world_bbox: viewer normalization is not evidence of shared source canonical geometry
glb_roundtrip.network: loopback only, no mocked model service or external assets

failure_policy: retain requested failures, reject mismatched pins/topology/mask/condition and existing output directories; no favorable subset selection
